@@U03923@@
In your youthful bloom and fame! With sharp eye you scanned the world, To you the human heart was known, Noble women’s love regaled you, Yours a music all your own! And yet you ran in wild defiance Straight into the fatal snare, Daring law and staid convention, Proving that you didn’t care. But at the last a higher yearning Gave your mighty courage weight; Glorious the goals you strove for, Yet it was not to be your fate. But whose fate zs it? Dismal question, At which Fate averts her eyes, When on that day of greatest misery A nation bleeds and dumbly cries. So strike up new songs, bright and merry, Renew your spirit, banish pain! Earth has borne us songs forever, And earth will bear us songs again!

@@U03924@@
(Complete pause. The music ceases.)

@@U03926@@
(To 浮士德)

@@U03927@@
An ancient proverb proves itself in me: that Beauty and Happiness can have no lasting union. The bond of life and the bond of love are snapped. Mourning both, my lord, I bid you a painful farewell, and give myself once more into your arms. 珀耳塞福涅, receive my boy and me! (She embraces 浮士德. Her body vanishes; her dress and veil remain in his arms.)

@@U03929@@
(To FAUSH)

@@U03930@@
Hold fast to what remains to you of 海伦!
translation:
@@U03923@@
在你的青春绽放和成名中！你用锐利的眼睛扫视世界，你了解人心，贵族女人的爱让你享受，你的音乐属于你自己！然而你却狂野地反抗，直奔致命的网罗，大胆的法律和保守的惯例，证明你不在乎。但最后，一种更高的渴望给了你巨大的勇气；你为之奋斗的目标是光荣的，但这并不是你的命运。但这是谁的命运呢？令人沮丧的问题，命运避开了她的目光，在那个最痛苦的日子，一个国家流血，无声地哭泣。所以，唱起新歌吧，明亮而快乐，更新你的精神，消除痛苦！地球永远为我们带来了歌曲，地球将再次为我们带来歌曲！

@@U03924@@
（完全停顿。音乐停止。）

@@U03926@@
（致浮士德）

@@U03927@@
一句古老的谚语在我身上证明了自己：美丽和幸福不可能有持久的结合。生命的纽带和爱情的纽带都断了。陛下，我向您痛苦地告别，并再次投入您的怀抱。 珀耳塞福涅，接收我和我的孩子！ （她拥抱浮士德。她的身体消失了；她的衣服和面纱仍然留在他的怀里。）

@@U03929@@
（致福斯）

@@U03930@@
紧紧抓住海伦剩下的一切！
